macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stock futures rise as Micron outlook boosts chip shares
items.summary: U.S. stock futures were mixed to higher as Micron’s stronger-than-expected results and upbeat guidance supported semiconductor and AI-related stocks. Investors also monitored elevated Treasury yields and the upcoming U.S. jobs report.[3][7]

items.title: Treasury yields remain near multiyear highs
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield approached 5.35%, a level described as a fresh 24-year high, adding pressure to equity valuations and increasing market focus on interest-rate policy.[9]

items.title: Fed officials signal concern about inflation and neutral rates
items.summary: Fed officials said economic growth is near trend and the labor market is close to full employment, while inflation remains too high. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari raised his neutral-rate estimate to 3.25%, implying policy may be less restrictive than previously believed.[1][8]

items.title: Micron reports major earnings beat and strong guidance
items.summary: Micron reported adjusted fourth-quarter earnings of $33.42 per share and revenue of $54.23 billion, with revenue up nearly 400% year over year. The company also issued an upbeat first-quarter outlook, strengthening the AI-chip trade.[9]

items.title: Accenture and McCormick shares jump after earnings
items.summary: Accenture shares rose about 18% and McCormick shares gained roughly 5% in premarket trading following their quarterly results. Nike was also scheduled to report earnings during the session.[9][7]

items.title: Alphabet unveils Gemini 4 Argon AI model
items.summary: Alphabet shares rose about 1.5% before the open after the company introduced Gemini 4 Argon, described as its most advanced artificial-intelligence model.[9]

items.title: U.S. labor-market data shows continuing claims below expectations
items.summary: Continuing jobless claims were reported at 1.701 million, below the 1.730 million estimate, while markets awaited the next major employment report and additional Federal Reserve commentary.[1]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $83,850 After Brief Move Above $85,000
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $83,850, up about 0.4% over 24 hours after briefly reaching roughly $85,500. The total cryptocurrency market capitalization rose about 0.3% to $2.96 trillion, while Ether gained approximately 0.8% to $2,696.

items.title: Crypto Market Volatility Intensifies as Liquidations Near $300 Million
items.summary: About 80,600 traders were liquidated for approximately $294 million over 24 hours, with long and short liquidations nearly evenly split. Bitcoin’s gains were pressured by sharply higher U.S. Treasury yields and mixed inflation data.

items.title: MetaMask Reports Infrastructure Security Incident
items.summary: MetaMask disclosed that part of its infrastructure was affected by a security incident but said it found no evidence of a direct threat to users’ wallets. The disclosure added to market concerns during a volatile trading session.

items.title: NEAR Intents Halts Services After Estimated $3.8 Million Loss
items.summary: NEAR Intents suspended services after a bug in its Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure reportedly caused approximately $3.8 million to move across crypto networks.

items.title: Dogecoin-Based DogeOS Launches Testnet
items.summary: DogeOS launched a public testnet designed to support EVM-compatible smart contracts, including lending applications and games built on top of the Dogecoin ecosystem.

items.title: CFTC Wins More Than $30 Million Judgment in Fundsz Fraud Case
items.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission secured a judgment exceeding $30 million against defendants in the Fundsz cryptocurrency fraud case.

items.title: XRP Ledger Surpasses 10 Million x402 Payments
items.summary: The XRP Ledger processed more than 10 million payments through the x402 protocol, which supports automated payments by AI agents for computing and data services.

items.title: U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETFs See September Inflows but End Month With Outflows
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $2.65 billion in net inflows during September, followed by about $148.7 million in outflows on September 30.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: London Studio Behind Reigns Series Closes
items.summary: The London-based studio associated with the Reigns series has reportedly shut down, marking a notable development for the independent games sector.

items.title: Kena: Scars of Kosmora Delayed to 2027
items.summary: Kena: Scars of Kosmora has reportedly been postponed to 2027, delaying the next major release in the adventure series.

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 Releases Across Major Platforms
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 is now available on PC, PlayStation 4 and 5, Xbox One and Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch. It also debuted at No. 1 on the UK software chart for the week ending September 26, 2026.

items.title: Star Wars Jedi 3 Reportedly Targeting 2027
items.summary: An insider claims the next Star Wars Jedi game could be revealed before The Game Awards in December 2026 and launch in 2027; Electronic Arts has not officially confirmed the report.

items.title: Sony Reportedly Exploring a New Ape Escape
items.summary: A report suggests Sony may be considering a new Ape Escape project, though no game has been officially announced.

items.title: Take-Two Signs Long-Term Xbox Publishing Agreement
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive reportedly signed a long-term publishing agreement covering Xbox devices, including future hardware currently in development.

items.title: Next-Generation Updates Planned for Metro Games
items.summary: A next-generation update for Metro games has reportedly been announced, although detailed release timing and feature information were limited in the available report.
